lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Miranda,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Miranda, where are you?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Reply to me!
What's the matter?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: We're responding to an emergency call, but we can't find Miranda.
What happened?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Apparently, someone is running around

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: in the middle of the road shaking a chew toy

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: trying to catch a stray dog.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: They're blocking traffic.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Sorry for the late reply!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: You should be.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Why aren't you at the police station?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Didn't I tell you not to leave your post?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: What's the meaning of all this?!
Yikes, someone's a little upset...

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I had something to report to you,

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: but I couldn't find you. So I went out by myself.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Do you not know how a phone works?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: You could have tried texting me!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I thought I'd be back soon...

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Sorry, next time I'll be sure to text you first before anything else.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: ... Fine then.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: So where are you right now anyway?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Right now?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I'm on the road shaking this chew toy.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: You're the one we received a call about?!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Guess so!
Now that's something you don't see every day.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: What are you doing on the road?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I was watching the surveillance cameras, and a puppy caught my attention, so I went over right away.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Don't worry, Poli.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: I'll handle this!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Stay right there and don't go anywhere!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I said stay there, and don't do anything!
Why?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: If I leave this in Miranda's hands,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: it'll take twice as long to break up this gridlock.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Not to mention how many more issues she may end up causing...

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I need to intervene before things get any worse.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I doubt she'll even be able to catch that dog on her own.
I can definitely see that being the case.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: She's more of a hindrance than anything.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: So, do you copy, Miranda?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Just wait there and don't do anything.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: So I kan't even shake the chew toy?

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: can't, sorry.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: That's right. Don't even shake it a little bit.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Just stand at attention and don't move.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: If people found out this traffic jam is all because of a police officer bumbling about, we'd never hear the end of it.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Yes, ma'am! I'll wait right here.
